title: Study: Data Centers’ Air Pollution Harm Reaches Far From Their Walls
paragraphs: Data centers use a lot of electricity. Many power plants make this electricity. Some plants burn gas and make dirty air.
Scientists at MIT made a computer model. They studied the United States in 2023. They say dirty air from this power caused about 650 early deaths.
The model shows that people far from data centers can also be hurt. The air moves a long way. Scientists want to learn more.

questions.q: How many early deaths did the study find for 2023?
Can people far from data centers be hurt?
questions.a: Yes, the air moves a long way.
